assignment: Write a field allocation memo under the stated access and sampling constraints.
source: A team can visit six plots once this month. Four river plots have complete three-year histories, two upland plots had unusually low cover last year, and four accessible roadside plots are new. At least two river revisits are required for a funding agreement. Roadsides are convenient but unrepresentative. A second visit is possible next quarter.

criteria.full: Allocates exactly six visits with at least two river revisits, stating the treatment of all three plot types.
criteria.partial: Suggests a plausible mix without a complete count or funding check.

criteria.full: Explains how repeat sites, low-cover selection and convenient roadsides support different inferences.
criteria.partial: Notes that selection matters without identifying a specific bias.

criteria.full: Compares at least two feasible allocations in terms of continuity, anomaly follow-up or geographic representation.
criteria.partial: Provides only one allocation with little justification.

criteria.full: Gives a measurable next-quarter decision, including how new plots will be selected or revisited.
criteria.partial: Mentions next quarter without a selection trigger.
